selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who is the First Group in this passage?
questions.answer: They are the blessed and righteous people who followed the Master, listened to the Messenger, and paid attention to the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are the two roles of the Master described in the passage?
questions.answer: He is a servant who worships Allah and speaks of his Lord, and he is also a messenger who delivers Allah’s commands to people and jinn through the Qur’an.

questions.question: In worship, what kind of position does the Master have for his community?
questions.answer: He stands like a representative of his community before Allah.

questions.question: In messengership, how are Allah’s decrees delivered according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are conveyed through the Qur’an to human beings and jinn.

questions.question: What did this happy community realize about the prescribed prayers?
questions.answer: They understood that the prayers gather many kinds of worship and contain many refined duties and high spiritual ranks.

questions.question: What was their first spiritual reaction when they observed Allah’s acts in creation?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah in awe.

questions.question: What main picture of the First Group is given at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: They are presented as fortunate, upright believers who obeyed the Master and followed the Qur’an.

questions.question: Why is the Master called the possessor of two wings in meaning?
questions.answer: Because he has two great functions: devoted worship of Allah and delivery of Allah’s message.

questions.question: How is the Master’s worshipful side described?
questions.answer: He describes and presents his Lord as a devoted servant on behalf of his community.

questions.question: How is the Master’s messenger side described?
questions.answer: He passes Allah’s commands to jinn and human beings through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What did the community do with the Messenger and the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They listened carefully and followed their guidance.

questions.question: What was their first duty after observing divine activity in the universe?
questions.answer: They exalted Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of people make up the First Group?
questions.answer: They are successful and virtuous believers who accepted the guidance of the Messenger and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the Master’s connection to Allah and to creation?
questions.answer: He serves Allah in worship and conveys Allah’s message to people and jinn.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the community’s happiness to their actions?
questions.answer: Their happiness comes from listening to the Messenger and following the Qur’an.

questions.question: What broader meaning did they find in the prescribed prayers?
questions.answer: They saw them as a map of many kinds of worship, responsibilities, and spiritual positions.

questions.question: What did they see in the prescribed prayers besides outward ritual?
questions.answer: They saw many kinds of worship, refined duties, and lofty spiritual stations.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the formulas and movements of prayer?
questions.answer: They are not empty actions; they point to deeper meanings, stations, and duties.

questions.question: What basic choice set the First Group apart in this passage?
questions.answer: They chose to listen to the Master and follow the Qur’an.

questions.question: What two dimensions of the Master’s mission are explained?
questions.answer: One is worship and representing his community before Allah, and the other is delivering Allah’s commands as His Messenger.

questions.question: Who receives the message brought through the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: Both human beings and jinn receive it.

questions.question: What did the community come to understand about salah?
questions.answer: They understood that it contains many forms of worship and points to many spiritual tasks and ranks.

questions.question: What deeper understanding did they gain about prayer?
questions.answer: They saw that prayer includes and points to many forms of worship and many elevated spiritual duties.

questions.question: How are the people of the First Group described at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: They are described as truly fortunate and morally good.

title: Transition to Reality Believers Listening to the Messenger and Entering High Stations Through Prayer
